:::{#def-nested-cv}
#### Nested cross-validation

**Nested cross-validation** is [$k$-fold cross-validation](#def-kfold)
of a [fitting procedure](#def-fitting-procedure) that itself
chooses among candidate fitting procedures by cross-validation
and then applies the chosen one.
So for each outer [fold](#def-folds) $\fold{j}$,
the whole choice, inner cross-validation included,
uses only the observations outside $\fold{j}$,
and its [fold-out rule](#def-fold-out-rule) $\fittedwo{j}{\cdot}$
is scored on $\fold{j}$ as in @eq-cv-estimate-by-fold:

$$
\frac{1}{n} \sum_{j=1}^k \sum_{i \in \fold{j}} \sqf{\fittedwo{j}{x_i} - y_i}.
$$ {#eq-nested-cv}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

@hastie2009elements [sec. 7.10.2] for cross-validating every step of a procedure,
choices included.
:::
